notes.title: Freelancer Life Simulator: Prologue Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are happy to announce the release date of Freelancer Life Simulator: Prologue. Starting from 4.02.2021 the Prologue version of the game will be available for free on the Steam platform.

Do not forget to join us in the game Discord channel so as not to miss interesting information about the game.

In the initial versions of the game, minor bugs are possible, if you find them, report them in Discord, mail or Steam community.

We are waiting for everyone in the game.

Best regards, 
DiamosDev.
